Cyan means normal. A slow amber pulse is an anomaly under 50%, and an amber-red chase is 50% or more. Red means screen recording or a confirmed problem, orange means voice recording, teal means recalling a memory, and white means unknown.

resources.string: The chirp came back buried in noise, so this scan was not scored or saved to the place. Press the phone flat against the surface, keep still and quiet for two seconds, and scan again.
Scanning got more accurate. Teach this place\'s dry spot again before trusting scores.

The scan recorded silence, so there is nothing to score and it was not saved. Close any app that is using the microphone or sending phone audio elsewhere (screen sharing, remote control, calls, Bluetooth audio), turn the volume up, and scan again.
AquaScope has nothing to compare against yet. Only save dry scans as the baseline. Damp scans are taught to the detector later.

Extra abilities for Ask. Text skills guide the model; Wikipedia, hashing, and email run as tools on this phone.
Paste a Hugging Face token for Gemma models. Download Gemma 3 (.task), Gemma 4 E4B GPU (~3 GB), or full Gemma 4 E4B (~3.7 GB). Ask still works with rules if you skip this.
This model is already on the phone. Replace only if the file is corrupt. A full download will run again.
Paste a token that starts with hf_ first
Token already saved. Paste a new one to replace it.
No token saved — Gemma download will fail until you paste one.
Gemma is gated. Paste your Hugging Face token (starts with hf_), save it, then download.
Use the Gemma file in Downloads

Edge Gallery cannot share its private copy with this app. Downloading Gemma there does not install it here.

1. In this app: System → Download Gemma 3 1B (.task), Gemma 4 E4B GPU (~3 GB), or full Gemma 4 E4B (~3.7 GB).
2. Or export/share a model file into Downloads, then Import.
3. Optional: download Whisper Tiny, then enable Ollama translation for non-English voice.
4. Turn on agent skills for Wikipedia / hash / email / kitchen adventure.
5. Turn on “Use local model when available”, then open Ask SMRITI.

Ask still works with rules if no model is installed. Never rely on the model for leak confirmation.
Whisper Tiny turns speech into text on this phone. For questions that are not in English, SMRITI can ask Ollama on your PC to translate first.
On the PC, run: ollama pull gemma4:e4b. Without it, ML Kit still reads the text on this phone.
